Results.ReviewText: I was tired of going through cheaper grills every couple of years so I took my son's advice and got the Weber Spirit II. I have used it about a half dozen times so far and am very pleased not only with its performance, but how easy it is to keep clean. I have never been able to keep a grill so clean with so little effort. The design of the firebox is one of the main things that drew me to this unit as decaying fireboxes destroyed my last 3 grills. I don't see that happening with this one. Everything on this unit feels substantial and like it will last. Since I am usually only cooking for 2, the E-210 has proven to be a great size for me. Also, the 2 big wheels instead of 4 small caster wheels is so much better than most of my old grills.
Results.Title: Quality sets it apart

Results.ReviewText: The grill works very well and most of the design is thoughtful.  However, several of the metal parts were seriously bent and dented on arrival.  In my judgment this could not have happened in shipping - the packaging is a complex fortress.  I was equipped to straighten the parts and continue do the assembly (rather than wait for replacements).  I am not confident that the many plastic assembly bolts are a great idea, and some of the bendy construction feels a bit light-duty.  The end tables do not inspire admiration.  When I used it for the first time - preheating per instructions - after cooling a large crack appeared along one edge of the lid (photo).  Weber will send a replacement, but good grief, what is going on with quality?
Results.Title: Works great but quality issues

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
